feature: Deck state — the one row that survives, and Status's seven
note: ONE row under `Deck state` now — `Edited since last version` — and seven under Status. The phase the facet used to carry is `New` and `Draft` up there, because a facet duplicating two status rows can only disagree with them. Both renderings are photographed: a `FilterPanel` in the wide chassis and a chip group in the phone sheet. No `shares` block, deliberately — those are two components by design (`decks-view.tsx` mounts the panel, `deck-filter-sheet.tsx` draws chips), the same split every other facet on this route has, so a binding here would fail a correct build. What a picture adds over the tests: the heading sits directly after Status, Status itself now lists seven rows in cascade order, and the wide row does not wrap — `probe:deck-statuses` measures the wrap, this shows the placement. Same /about precondition as `deck-statuses.json`.
